title: LEVEL8 Hard-Shell Suitcase XL — 105 L Polycarbonate with TSA Lock
short_description: Large XL hard-shell suitcase with 105 litres of space, made of 100% polycarbonate, with spinner wheels and a TSA combination lock.
long_description: The LEVEL8 hard-shell suitcase in size XL offers 105 litres of space and measures 76 x 50.5 x 30 cm. The hard shell is made of 100% polycarbonate with a micro-diamond texture and weighs 5.81 kg. It rolls on spinner wheels and has a telescopic handle. The TSA combination lock secures the contents. Inside, a fabric lining, a zippered divider and tie-down straps keep things organised. Colour: black.
